dedupe_keys.name: access central office traffic generator from measurements

description: The B5G-OPEN team publishes an R implementation that partitions access-network nodes using their traffic profiles. The March 2023 Zenodo archive states CC BY 4.0 and free access; the linked repository describes the same algorithm without a separate licence declaration. Inputs specify a number of nodes and residential or business traffic patterns. The documented capacity condition requires each group’s summed traffic to remain below sixteen twenty-five-Gb/s channels, or 400 Gb/s, throughout the day. The resulting clusters can support point-to-multipoint optical-network capacity simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the implementation. Geographic coverage, measured-profile dates and temporal sampling are not stated in the README. Its use of “optimal” is a provider description, not an independently checked guarantee of a global optimum. Limitations include untested dependencies, input-profile availability and handling of infeasible configurations. The archive was not downloaded or executed.
